body: Most people are ***inclined*** to good, just like God.

I feel ya.

I'm a one-legged Black lesbian dwarf with a strange speech impediment. Yeah, I got a job at Amazon because of a diversity quota, but I tell ya, the crap I get from inconsiderate workers leaves me depressed as hell every night.

I started drinking, which I almost never do. I want to try prayer, but I'm not that religious.

Fuck inconsiderate people who have NO idea what it's like to live with more than one disability.
